help.source_dir: Each image needs a matching .txt caption, such as a.png and a.txt. Images with missing or empty captions after processing are skipped. Source files stay unchanged.
help.ignore_first: Remove this many tags from the start of each caption, for example a character trigger. Use 0 to keep all tags.
help.exclude_tags: Remove exact tag matches. Separate tags with commas. Processed captions are saved with the generated images.
help.sampler: Determines how each step removes noise.
help.scheduler: Distributes noise levels across sampling steps.
help.steps: Sampling steps per image. More steps take longer and do not always improve quality.
help.cfg: Prompt guidance strength. Higher values usually follow the prompt more closely; excessive values can cause artifacts.
help.seed: Use -1 for a random seed each round, or an integer to reproduce a round. Images use different seeds, preserved when resuming.
help.per_image: Regularization images to generate for each source. Images run one at a time; this does not increase the simultaneous batch size.
help.expand_repeats: Multiply the image count by the source folder's training repeats. Usually leave off to avoid generating too many images.
help.size_mode: Determines the dimensions of generated images.
help.flow_shift: Adjusts the noise time distribution. Usually keep the default.
help.blocks_to_swap: Move model blocks to RAM to save VRAM at the cost of slower generation. 0 disables offloading.
help.text_encoder_cpu: Process prompts on the CPU to save VRAM, at the cost of slower text encoding.
help.gpu_index: GPU used for generation, numbered from 0. Keep 0 for a single GPU.
help.bucket_no_upscale: Keep bucket dimensions within the source image size, avoiding larger output dimensions for small sources.
help.min_bucket_reso: Lower boundary for candidate bucket dimensions. Usually keep the training setting.
help.max_bucket_reso: Upper boundary for candidate bucket dimensions. Usually keep the training setting.
help.bucket_reso_steps: Increment between bucket dimensions. Smaller increments match source ratios more closely. Usually keep the training setting.

memory_mode.auto: Select inference precision and model offloading. SDXL encodes text on CPU, keeps the UNet on GPU when VRAM permits, otherwise offloads layers, and decodes with an FP32 VAE. Very large images may still exceed VRAM.
memory_mode.manual: Set inference precision, block offloading, and the text encoding device yourself.

sampler.euler: First-order sampling with one model evaluation per step.
sampler.euler_a: Also called Euler a. Adds random noise during sampling.
sampler.heun: Second-order correction, usually two evaluations per step. Slower than euler at the same step count.
sampler.dpmpp_2m: Second-order multistep sampling. Reuses the previous result without adding random noise.
sampler.dpmpp_2m_sde: Second-order multistep sampling that adds random noise.
sampler.er_sde: Stochastic sampling with higher-order estimates from previous denoising results.

scheduler.simple: Selects entries at fixed intervals from the model's discrete timestep table.
scheduler.normal: Uniform schedule including the minimum model timestep. Distinct from simple.
scheduler.sgm_uniform: Uniform schedule that omits the minimum model timestep before finishing denoising.
scheduler.beta: Allocates timesteps with a Beta distribution. Duplicate timesteps are merged, so fewer steps may run.
scheduler.karras: Power-law noise levels with denser sampling at lower noise levels.
scheduler.exponential: Exponential noise levels with a constant ratio between adjacent levels.
scheduler.flux2: Computes Flow shift automatically from resolution and step count. No manual adjustment needed.
scheduler.linear: Evenly spaced timesteps followed by the manually configured Flow shift.

size_mode.auto: Choose the closest source aspect ratio: 1024×1024, 832×1216, or 1216×832.
size_mode.fixed: All images use the width and height specified below.
size_mode.bucket: Uses source aspect ratios and training resolution, with optional training bucket settings.

precision.bf16: Default precision with a wider numerical range. Usually keep this option.
precision.fp16: Half precision with a narrower numerical range. Select only when this precision is needed.

monitor.diagnosticEvidenceConverging: The recent average fell {magnitude}, meeting the ≤ -{converging}% decrease rule; volatility {volatility} remains below the {volatile}% alert threshold.
monitor.diagnosticEvidencePlateau: The average change {magnitude} is < {plateauChange}% and volatility {volatility} is < {plateauVolatility}%, meeting the plateau rule.
monitor.diagnosticEvidenceRebound: The recent average rose {magnitude}, meeting the ≥ +{rebound}% rebound rule; rebound has first priority.
monitor.diagnosticEvidenceVolatile: Recent volatility {volatility} meets the ≥ {volatile}% alert rule; average change is {change}.
monitor.diagnosticEvidenceSteady: Average change {change} and volatility {volatility} match none of the decrease, rebound, high-volatility, or plateau rules.
monitor.diagnosticWindowEvidence: Step {recentStart}–{recentEnd} vs Step {previousStart}–{previousEnd} · {window} points per period
monitor.diagnosticMethodMeta: Engineering alert · not a quality score
monitor.diagnosticScopeText: This only analyzes training Loss, not sample images or validation Loss. It cannot determine image quality, overfitting, or the best checkpoint, and never stops training automatically.
monitor.diagnosticMethodSourceText: Prefers TensorBoard loss/average (the trainer moving average, typically covering about one epoch); falls back to noisier loss/current when unavailable.
monitor.diagnosticMethodWindowText: Compares two adjacent windows of up to 60 raw valid records each. Shorter histories use half the available records per window.
monitor.diagnosticMethodVolatilityText: Recent-window standard deviation divided by the absolute mean. Measures relative loss fluctuation; higher values mean more fluctuation.
monitor.diagnosticMethodNote: Diagnostics use the last 120 raw records, independently of chart downsampling. Open TensorBoard for full curves and point-level inspection.

field.compile_fullgraphMossConflict: Fullgraph compilation cannot be combined with block swapping, split attention, or xformers. Disable fullgraph.
field.checkpointOffloadConflict: Choose either standard CPU offload or Unsloth asynchronous offload.
field.blockSwapOffloadConflict: Block swapping cannot be combined with CPU or Unsloth activation offloading.
field.blockSwapFullgraphConflict: Block swapping supports per-block compilation, but requires fullgraph to be disabled.
field.compile_fullgraphAttentionConflict: Fullgraph compilation cannot be combined with split attention or xformers. Disable fullgraph or change the attention settings.
field.base_weightsConvrotConflict: LoRA pre-merging is not supported with ConvRot INT8 models. Use unquantized checkpoints and turn off both ConvRot options.
field.resolutionHint_moss: Enter width,height, such as 1024,768. Both dimensions must be positive multiples of 16. Bucketing uses this value as the target training area.
field.bucket_reso_stepsHint_moss: Round bucket dimensions to this step, a positive multiple of 16. Smaller steps allow more bucket sizes.
field.text_encoder_batch_size_mossHint: Qwen encodes captions one at a time. Increasing this value does not make it encode multiple captions together; usually leave it at 1.
field.pretrained_model_name_or_pathHint_moss: Select a MOSS DiT .safetensors file or its first shard. Keep all shards in the same directory.
field.vaeHint_moss: Supports standard and Small FLUX.2 VAEs. Small is the smaller decoder bundled with official MOSS weights. Both encode and decode in float32; Qwen-Image VAEs are incompatible.
field.text_encoder_mossHint: Select a Qwen3.5-9B file or its first shard. Supports BF16 and ConvRot INT8, but not W4A8 GPTQ. The encoder stays frozen.
field.mossTextEncoderFrozen: Qwen stays frozen. Only DiT adapters are trained.
field.tokenizer_cache_dir_mossHint: Leave empty to fetch the MOSS tokenizer automatically. Offline, select its complete directory containing tokenizer_config.json, or a Hugging Face cache that already contains it.
field.train_text_embedder_mossHint: Also trains adapters for the DiT text projection and two refiner blocks to adjust text conditioning. Qwen stays frozen and text caching remains available.
field.moss_max_token_length_mossHint: The limit includes the chat template; text beyond it is truncated. Lowering it can reduce VRAM use and computation for long captions. Rebuild disk text caches after changing it.
field.enable_multiline_caption_mossHint: Keeps full multiline captions. Multiple candidates can be cached and randomly selected during training. New caches rebuild after caption or prefix/suffix changes; legacy caches or skipped checks require manual rebuilding.
field.multiline_caption_separator_mossHint: Place the separator on its own line between caption candidates; a trailing # comment is allowed. Requires “Preserve caption line breaks”.
field.convrot_int8_mossHint: Quantizes linear-layer weights in the main DiT blocks to INT8 at load time to save VRAM; incompatible with merging LoRA weights before training. Leave this off for ConvRot prequantized weights. Uses a slower fallback when Triton is not installed.
field.convrot_int8_text_encoder_mossHint: Quantizes Qwen weights at load time to reduce VRAM use during text encoding; incompatible with merging LoRA weights before training. Leave this off for ConvRot prequantized weights.
field.convrot_int8_bwd_mossHint: Only affects backward computation in ConvRot INT8 layers.
field.sample_uncond_skip_layers_moss: Layers skipped in the negative branch
field.sample_uncond_skip_layers_mossHint: Skips layers in the preview's negative CFG branch. Enter comma-separated indices 0–41; blank disables skipping. No effect at CFG=1.
field.sample_promptsHint_moss: All content forms one positive prompt, preserving line breaks; JSON layout descriptions are supported. With text caching enabled, finalize it before training starts.
field.negative_promptsHint_moss: Describe what to avoid in previews. All content forms one negative prompt with line breaks preserved. May be empty; has no effect at CFG=1. With text caching enabled, finalize it before training starts.
field.compileHint_moss: Compiles each DiT block, including ConvRot INT8 layers. Cannot be enabled alongside Accelerate compilation.
field.compile_fullgraphHint_moss: Requires each DiT block to compile without graph breaks. Supports ConvRot INT8; incompatible with block swapping, split attention, and xformers.
field.timestep_samplingHint_moss: Controls how often each noise level is sampled. New configurations use truncated_logit_normal to reproduce MOSS pre-training sampling with truncation and 1% uniform mixing. Existing configurations keep their values.
field.timestep_samplingHint_anima: Controls how often each noise level is sampled. New Anima configurations default to sigmoid; inspect each range's share in the distribution preview.
field.max_data_loader_n_workersHint_moss: Increase the number of workers if data loading holds up training, at the cost of RAM. 0 loads in the main process; blank uses up to 8 workers. On Windows, 2 is a starting point.
field.network_alphaHint_moss: Standard LoRA scales adapter outputs by Alpha/Rank. Reassess the learning rate after changing Alpha.
field.learning_rateHint_moss: Controls the size of parameter updates; too high a value can make training unstable. A separate DiT learning rate takes priority.
field.unet_lrHint_moss: Leave empty to use the base learning rate, or set a rate for DiT adapters. network_reg_lrs can further override the learning rate for matching modules.
field.mixed_precisionHint_moss: Keep bf16 for MOSS's bf16 weights; fp16 is prone to overflow. This does not change Qwen's BF16/INT8 or the VAE's FP32 precision.
field.sample_flow_shiftHint_moss: Shifts preview denoising steps within the noise range: higher values favor high noise, lower values favor low noise. Only affects previews.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputsHint_moss: Pre-encodes captions so Qwen can be moved to the CPU to free VRAM once caching is complete. Supports whole-caption dropout. Rebuild disk text caches after changing captions, token limit, whole-caption dropout probability, or the text encoder.
field.shuffle_captionHint_moss: Shuffles caption tags while keeping retained tags in place. Multiline captions are left unchanged when “Preserve caption line breaks” is enabled. Requires disabling both memory and disk text caches.
field.caption_tag_dropout_rateHint_moss: Probability of randomly dropping tags; retained tags are exempt. 0 disables dropout. Multiline captions are left unchanged when “Preserve caption line breaks” is enabled. Above 0, disable both memory and disk text caches.
field.ip_noise_gammaHint_moss: Adds random noise to the model input without changing the training target. Leave empty or set to 0 to disable.
field.blocks_to_swapHint_moss: Moves some DiT blocks to system RAM to save VRAM, increasing RAM use and transfer overhead. Maximum 40 blocks; 0 disables swapping. Incompatible with CPU or Unsloth activation offloading.
field.pretrained_model_name_or_pathHint: Accepts .safetensors / .ckpt model files or a Diffusers-format directory.
field.pretrained_model_name_or_pathHint_anima: Select Cosmos-Predict2-2B derivative weights compatible with Anima.
field.vaeHint: Encodes images into latents and decodes latents into images. For SDXL, leave empty to use the base model's VAE. Anima requires a compatible Qwen-Image VAE.
field.vaeHint_anima: Requires a Qwen-Image VAE compatible with Anima.
field.vaeHint_sdxl: Leave blank to use the VAE bundled with the SDXL base model.
field.krea_ditHint: Select a single RAW BF16 or ConvRot INT8 .safetensors file. Detecting INT8 automatically enables ConvRot INT8 and disables FP8. Pre-scaled FP8 checkpoints are unsupported.
field.krea_vaeHint: Encodes training images into latents for the image cache.
field.krea_text_encoderHint: Select a single Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct BF16 .safetensors file. ConvRot INT8 files, scaled FP8 files and Hugging Face directories are unsupported. It prepares caption caches and encodes preview prompts, remaining frozen during LoRA training.
field.krea_dataset_cache_dirHint: Created automatically inside the training data directory. Prepare caches again after changing images, captions, resolution, bucketing, the VAE, or the text encoder. Changing the training DiT does not affect these caches.
field.krea_resolutionHint: Enter width,height. Both must be positive multiples of 16. With bucketing, this sets the target image area; each bucket sets the actual dimensions. Without bucketing, images are resized and cropped to this size.
field.krea_num_repeatsHint: Samples per image in each epoch. More repeats increase the sample count when training by epoch; a fixed total step count keeps the number of updates unchanged.
field.krea_train_data_dirHint: Select the training image directory. Keep images beside matching captions, such as image.png and image.txt. Set repeats for all images with Repeats per image.
field.krea_decompose_bothHint: Allow both Kronecker factors to use low-rank decomposition, depending on layer dimensions and rank. Does not apply in full-matrix mode.
field.krea_unbalanced_factorizationHint: Swaps the two output-dimension factors, changing W1/W2 shapes and parameter allocation.
field.krea_lokr_factorHint: Controls the Kronecker factor split. Use -1 for automatic selection or a positive integer. Together with rank, this determines whether each layer uses low-rank factors.
field.krea_lokr_rankHint: Each layer selects low-rank or full factors from its factorized dimensions. Once a factor becomes full, increasing rank does not increase its parameter count.
field.krea_target_modeHint: All algorithms use the same scope. All Linear includes text fusion, input/output and time projections. Main-block scopes cover only the 28 DiT blocks. Custom regexes fully match original layer names.
field.krea_target_includeHint: One regex per line, fully matching original Linear names, e.g. blocks\.[0-9]+\.attn\..*. Select at least one target; .* includes all Linear layers.
field.krea_target_excludeHint: One full-match regex per line; exclusions take precedence. For example, txtfusion\..* excludes text fusion.
field.krea_rank_dropoutHint: Native LoRA and bypass-mode LoCon drop rank channels. LoHa and weight-rebuild LoCon drop output rows of the weight update. Range 0–0.99; 0 disables it. Use module dropout for the current LyCORIS LoKr path.
field.krea_locon_dropoutHint: Apply neuron dropout to the LoCon branch output. A nonzero value enables bypass mode. Set this to 0 with DoRA, which supports rank_dropout and module_dropout instead.
field.krea_paired_optimizerHint: LoRA-Muon and LoRA-RITE support native LoRA and LoCon with use_scalar and DoRA disabled. Both require paired updates and cannot be combined with LoRA+.
field.krea_learning_rateHint_lora_muon: The initial value is 0.1. LoRA-Muon has a different update scale from AdamW. Check loss and samples in a short run before tuning the learning rate.
field.krea_bypass_modeHint: Add adapter updates to the original layer output. Enabled automatically for FP8 or ConvRot INT8; DoRA requires quantization and bypass mode off.
field.krea_dora_fp8Conflict: Krea2 base quantization is incompatible with LyCORIS DoRA; disable FP8 / ConvRot INT8 or DoRA.
field.krea_factorRangeError: factor must be -1 (automatic) or a positive integer.
field.krea_network_argsHint: One key=value per line. Use the guided controls for algorithm, dropout and LoKr settings. LyCORIS targets use the target scope above. Legacy native LoRA include_patterns / exclude_patterns remain available under All Linear.
field.krea_weighting_schemeHint: logit_normal and mode change only sigma sampling density; sigma_sqrt and cosmap change only per-timestep Loss weights; none adds no adjustment.
field.krea_learning_rateHint: Controls the overall step size for DiT LoRA parameter updates. This training path has no separate text-encoder learning rate.
field.krea_logit_meanHint: Sets the distribution center for logsnr or sigma + logit_normal. Higher values favor lower noise; lower values favor higher noise. The two modes use different transforms, so the same value gives different distributions.
field.krea_logit_stdHint: Sets the spread for logsnr or sigma + logit_normal. Lower values concentrate samples; higher values cover a wider range.
field.krea_mode_scaleHint: Used only with sigma + mode. 0 samples noise-table indices uniformly; increasing it from 0 to the default 1.29 concentrates indices around the table's middle. Check the distribution preview for other values.
field.krea_optimizer_weight_decayHint: Controls parameter shrinkage during updates. Whether decay is decoupled from the gradient depends on the selected optimizer; 0 applies no weight decay.
field.krea_optimizer_betasHint: Enter comma-separated values, such as 0.9, 0.999. Values closer to 1 retain more history. See the selected optimizer's documentation for the number and meaning of the values.
field.krea_optimizer_epsHint: Adds this value to the adaptive update denominator or statistics to limit updates when the denominator is very small.
field.krea_prodigy_d_coefHint: Controls the estimation scale for Prodigy's automatic step size D, default 1.0.
field.krea_prodigy_d0Hint: Initial estimate of the automatic step size D for Prodigy and ProdigyPlus, default 1e-6.
field.krea_schedulefree_warmup_stepsHint: Controls only AdamWScheduleFree linear warmup; external lr_warmup_steps and the LR scheduler do not apply.
field.krea_adafactor_relative_stepHint: Computes the step size from the training step count. To use a manual learning rate and external scheduler, disable both this option and warmup_init.
field.krea_adafactor_scale_parameter: Scale AdaFactor steps by parameter size
field.krea_adafactor_scale_parameterHint: Scales the step size by each parameter's root mean square (RMS). relative_step selects an automatic base step size or the manually set learning rate.
field.krea_adafactor_warmup_initHint: Only applies in relative-step mode; AdaFactor performs the warmup internally.
field.krea_adafactor_clip_thresholdHint: Bounds the RMS of AdaFactor's internal update. Updates above the threshold are scaled down; lower values impose a stronger limit. Separate from global gradient clipping.
field.krea_adafactor_epsHint: Enter eps1, eps2, such as 1e-30, 1e-3. The first stabilizes squared-gradient statistics; the second sets a lower bound on the parameter RMS scale.
field.krea_lr_scheduler_internalLocked: This optimizer manages its own learning rate; the external scheduler has no effect.
field.krea_lr_scheduler_timescaleHint: Higher values slow decay after warmup. Follows the warmup step count, or 10000 without warmup, until manually changed. Ratio warmup assumes 10000 total steps while the total is unknown.
field.krea_lr_scheduler_min_lr_ratioHint: Minimum LR = base LR × this ratio. Used by cosine_with_min_lr, warmup_stable_decay, and rex; empty means 0.01 for REX and 0 for the other two.
field.krea_lr_scheduler_min_lr_ratioHint_rex: REX ends at base learning rate × this ratio. Blank uses 0.01, or 1% of the base rate.
field.krea_lr_scheduler_num_cyclesHint: For cosine_with_restarts this is the restart count; for cosine_with_min_lr it is the cosine cycle count; for warmup_stable_decay it is the final decay cycle count.
field.krea_fp8_baseHint: Quantizes target linear-layer weights in the BF16 base model's main blocks to scaled FP8, leaving text fusion layers unquantized. Reduces weight VRAM without guaranteeing faster training. Cannot be enabled with ConvRot INT8.
field.krea_compileHint: Compiles the Krea 2 DiT and may speed up training. The first run takes extra time to compile.
field.krea_text_cache_batch_sizeHint: Captions encoded by Qwen3-VL at once, independent of the training batch size. Reduce it when RAM or VRAM is insufficient.
field.krea_gradient_checkpointing_cpu_offloadH: Moves checkpoint intermediates to system RAM, saving VRAM at the cost of extra transfers. Requires gradient checkpointing.
field.krea_ratio_or_stepsHint: Use a whole number of steps, or a ratio below 1 (for example 0.1 means 10% of total steps).
field.krea_lr_decay_stepsHint: Used only by warmup_stable_decay. Enter whole steps or a ratio below 1 of total steps; 0 leaves no final decay segment.
field.krea_use_pinned_memory_for_block_swapHin: Uses pinned memory for block transfers. May speed up transfers but uses extra system RAM.
field.krea_block_swap_h2d_onlyHint: Experimental: avoids copying frozen weights back to CPU. Enables gradient checkpointing; disabling checkpointing turns this off.
field.krea_block_swap_ring_sizeHint: Default 2 overlaps transfers with computation. 1 saves VRAM without overlap. Capped at the swapped block count.
field.enable_krea_samplesHint: Writes previews to the sample folder in this run's model output directory. At training start, the text encoder loads temporarily to encode preview prompts.
field.krea_sample_promptsHint: Enter one prompt per line and finalize it before training starts. --w/--h set size, --s sets steps, --d sets the seed, and --l sets CFG. The negative branch requires CFG above 1 and a negative prompt supplied with --n. --g does not control CFG here.
field.krea_turbo_ditHint: Select a Turbo BF16 file to preview with the LoRA being trained. Leave empty to use RAW. Cannot be combined with block swap or ConvRot INT8; use Turbo LoRA sampling weights instead.
field.kreaTurboBlockSwapConflict: Turbo previews cannot be combined with block swapping. Clear Turbo DiT or set the number of swapped blocks to 0.
field.krea_turbo_dit_cache: Keep Turbo DiT resident in CPU memory
field.krea_turbo_dit_cacheHint: Keeps Turbo DiT in system RAM to avoid rereading its weights for every preview. Uses roughly one additional DiT's worth of system RAM throughout training.
field.resumeHint: Select a saved training-state directory to restore weights, optimizer, scheduler, and random-number state. Check the epoch or total-step settings for this run before continuing.
field.train_data_dirHint: Select the directory containing training subsets. Name subfolders repeats_subset, such as 10_character, and keep images and matching caption files inside them.
field.enable_reg_dataHint: Adds images from the same class to help preserve the model’s ability to generate that class while learning the target character or concept.
field.reg_data_dirHint: Directory of regularization images. Same structure as the training dataset: subfolders named "repeats_classname" (e.g. 10_face). Must be a separate directory, not inside the training data directory.
field.resolutionHint: Enter width,height, such as 1024,768. Without bucketing, images are resized and cropped to this size. With bucketing, it sets the target area, and buckets determine the dimensions. Both dimensions must be multiples of 16 for Anima or 32 for SDXL.
field.enable_bucketHint: Groups images with similar aspect ratios for training, helping preserve their proportions and reduce cropping.
field.krea_enable_bucketHint: Selects buckets by image aspect ratio. Candidate sizes are generated from the training resolution's area and aligned to 16 pixels. The current Krea 2 trainer has no separate minimum or maximum bucket-side settings.
field.krea_bucket_no_upscaleHint: Applies when bucketing is enabled. Images whose area does not exceed the target area keep their dimensions, rounded down to multiples of 16. Larger images use the generated candidate buckets.
field.bucket_no_upscaleHint: Avoids enlarging small images to the training size, so blur and compression artifacts are not magnified.
field.min_bucket_resoHint: Used to generate candidate buckets when upscaling is allowed. With no-upscale enabled, bucket sizes follow original image dimensions and the target area.
field.max_bucket_resoHint: Used to generate candidate buckets when upscaling is allowed. With no-upscale enabled, bucket sizes follow original image dimensions and the target area.
field.bucket_reso_stepsHint: Bucket dimensions are rounded to this increment. Smaller increments allow more bucket sizes. Must be a positive multiple of 16 for Anima or 32 for SDXL.
field.flip_augHint: Flips images horizontally with a 50% chance to vary their orientation. Not recommended for images with asymmetric features whose left/right placement must be preserved. Left/right descriptions in captions are not adjusted automatically.
field.random_cropHint: Chooses a random crop position when an image exceeds the bucket or training dimensions. Latent caching is unavailable with this option; the VAE must encode images during training.
field.cache_latentsLocked: Latent caching is unavailable while random cropping is enabled.
field.random_cropCacheDisabled: Random cropping enabled; memory and disk latent caching disabled.
field.save_precisionHint: Controls exported weight precision only, not training computation or optimizer states. Save training state separately to resume training.
field.save_every_n_stepsHint: Saves models by parameter-update count. Can be used alongside epoch-based saves.
field.log_grad_normHint: Logs the pre-clipping gradient norm per optimizer step in TensorBoard. Reuses clipping's norm when enabled; otherwise requires an extra norm reduction.
field.log_grad_clippedHint: Logs 1 when clipping is triggered and 0 otherwise, alongside the gradient norm. Requires gradient-norm logging.
field.log_timestep_loss: Log loss by noise range loss/timestep
field.log_timestep_lossHint: Logs current-batch, rolling-average, and epoch-average loss for low, middle, and high noise ranges, together with the corresponding standard loss records.
field.log_timestep_countHint: Periodically records the main process's cumulative sampling distribution since launch. View it in TensorBoard TIME SERIES.
field.save_stateHint: Saves weights, optimizer, scheduler, and random-number states at the configured intervals and when training ends, so training can be resumed. Usually takes more space than a LoRA file.
field.save_last_n_epochs_stateHint: Keeps the latest N epoch-based state saves; step-based and final states are separate. Blank follows model retention; if both are blank, no cleanup runs.
field.train_batch_sizeHint: Images processed at once per GPU; mainly affects per-pass VRAM. If memory runs out, lower this and use gradient accumulation to maintain samples per update.
field.gradient_accumulation_stepsHint: Updates once every N batches. For full batches, effective samples per update ≈ batch size × accumulation × GPU count. With fixed epochs, increasing this reduces updates.
field.gradient_checkpointingHint: Stores fewer intermediate tensors and recomputes them during backpropagation to reduce VRAM use. Adds repeated computation.
field.learning_rateHint: Controls the size of each update. With other settings unchanged, a higher rate means larger updates; separate component rates take priority. Retune after changing the optimizer or LoRA Alpha/Rank.
field.learning_rateHint_lora_muon: The starting value for Anima is 0.02. LoRA-Muon's update scale differs from AdamW, so tune its learning rate separately.
field.unet_lrHint: Leave empty to use the base learning rate, or set a separate rate for this component.
field.unet_lrHint_anima: Leave empty to use the base learning rate, or set a rate for DiT adapters. network_reg_lrs can further override the learning rate for matching modules.
field.text_encoder_lrHint: Applies only when training the text encoder. Leave blank to use the base learning rate.
field.lr_schedulerHint: Controls how the learning rate changes during training.
field.warmup_typeHint: Shapes the rise from the minimum LR ratio to the base rate. Skipped when warmup steps are 0.
field.decay_typeHint: Shapes the final descent to the minimum learning rate. Skipped when decay steps are 0.
field.step_rulesHint: Format: multiplier:end_step,multiplier:end_step,final_multiplier. Use commas and cumulative step boundaries. Example: 1:1000,0.5:1600,0.1 uses ×1 before step 1000, ×0.5 before step 1600, then ×0.1. No separate warmup.
field.step_rulesError: Use multiplier:end_step,...,final_multiplier; cumulative boundaries must be increasing positive integers and multipliers finite and non-negative.
field.lr_scheduler_num_cyclesHint: 1 gives a cosine descent to the minimum learning rate. Larger values add oscillations; check the curve preview.
field.lr_scheduler_num_cyclesHint_restarts: 1 means no restart during training. Larger values create multiple cosine cycles, returning to the base learning rate at each new cycle.
field.lr_scheduler_num_cyclesHint_wsd: Affects cosine decay only: 1 descends to the minimum, while larger values add oscillations. Ignored by linear and 1-sqrt.
field.lr_scheduler_timescaleHint: Larger values slow decay after warmup. Follows the warmup step count, or 10000 without warmup, unless overridden. Fractional warmup assumes 10000 total steps until an estimate is available.
field.lr_scheduler_min_lr_ratioHint: Minimum learning rate = each group's base rate × this ratio. 0.1 means 10%; 0 decays to zero.
field.lr_scheduler_min_lr_ratioHint_wsd: Sets both the warmup starting rate and the decay endpoint: each group's base rate × this ratio. The stable phase uses the base rate.
field.lr_decay_stepsHint: Enter steps or a fraction below 1: 0.2 uses the final 20%, and 0 skips decay. Steps outside warmup and decay form the stable phase.
field.lr_scheduler_powerHint: Used only by polynomial decay. 1 gives linear decay; values above 1 fall faster early on, and values below 1 fall more slowly early on.
field.lr_warmup_stepsHint: Gradually raises the learning rate at the start of training to avoid large initial updates. Enter a step count or a fraction of the total steps; 0.1 means 10%.
field.weight_decayHint: Shrinks trainable weights during updates to limit their growth. Excessive decay can hinder fitting. Set to 0 to disable.
field.bnb_min_8bit_sizeHint: Parameter tensors below this element count keep 32-bit optimizer states. A higher threshold quantizes fewer small tensors but uses more memory.
field.foreachHint: Controls whether the optimizer batches parameter updates.
field.stableadamw_kahan_sumHint: Compensates for rounding errors in low-precision parameter updates so small changes are less likely to be lost. Mainly useful for FP16 or BF16 trainable parameters.
field.stableadamw_weight_decoupleHint: Uses AdamW-style decoupled decay. It has no practical effect while weight_decay is 0.
field.muon_adjust_lr_fnHint: Selects how matrix updates are scaled. AdamW matching helps compare using an existing learning rate; reassess the rate after switching optimizers.
field.muon_momentumHint: Fraction of historical momentum retained. Default: 0.95; range: 0 ≤ momentum < 1. Higher values retain history longer; setting it to 1 stops gradient updates.
field.muonNonMatrixConflict: Muon only supports two-dimensional parameters. Disable this option or choose another optimizer.
field.muonMomentumRangeError: Muon momentum must be greater than or equal to 0 and less than 1.
field.muon_nesterovHint: When enabled, combines the current gradient with historical momentum before orthogonalization. When disabled, orthogonalizes only the accumulated momentum.
field.muon_ns_stepsHint: Number of iterations used to orthogonalize the update. More iterations require more computation; with the current coefficients, they do not necessarily improve accuracy.
field.muon_ns_coefficientsHint: The three coefficients used by the Newton-Schulz iteration. Keep the defaults unless you are running a controlled comparison.
field.lora_muon_momentumHint: Fraction of historical momentum retained. Default: 0.9. Higher values retain history longer and give the current gradient a smaller share of the momentum.
field.lora_muon_ns_stepsHint: Iterations for the matrix-sign approximation; default 8. Fewer iterations reduce computation but change the approximation.
field.lora_muon_inv_sqrt_stepsHint: Iterations for the Gram inverse square root; default 7. Fewer iterations reduce computation but change factor-scale correction.
field.lora_muon_msign_epsHint: Prevents division by zero in the matrix-sign calculation. Default: 1e-20.
field.lora_muon_inv_sqrt_epsHint: Default: 1e-5. Regularizes Gram matrices and participates in the cold-start threshold and eigenvalue floor. Changing it alters factor-scale correction.
field.lora_muon_inv_sqrt_gammaHint: Iteration damping for the Gram inverse square root, default 1.001. Stabilizes the numerical approximation.
field.lora_muon_gauge_rebalanceHint: Periodically balances the two LoRA factors so one does not become much larger than the other. Rebalancing preserves the weight change represented by their product.
field.lora_muon_gauge_rebalance_alphaHint: Controls how strongly each rebalance adjusts the factor scales. Lower values make smaller adjustments.
field.lora_muon_gauge_rebalance_intervalHint: Rebalances the two LoRA factors after every N parameter updates.
field.lora_muon_gauge_power_stepsHint: Estimates the maximum amplification of each factor to assess their scale imbalance. More iterations add computation.
field.lora_muonNetworkAutoSelected: LoRA-Muon supports only Anima native LoRA; the network module was switched to networks.lora_anima.
field.lora_muonOptimizerAutoDisabled: The selected network module does not support LoRA-Muon; the optimizer was switched to AdamW8bit.
field.adan_weight_decoupleHint: When enabled, multiplies weights by 1−LR×weight_decay before the gradient update. When disabled, divides them by 1+LR×weight_decay after the update. The two are equivalent when weight decay is 0.
field.ademamix_alphaHint: Multiplier for slow momentum in the update. Higher values increase the contribution of long-term gradient history; Beta3 controls how long that history is retained.
field.ademamix_t_alphaHint: Number of update steps used to increase the slow-momentum weight Alpha from 0 to its target. Empty uses the estimated total steps; 0 uses the target weight from the start.
field.ademamix_t_beta3Hint: Number of update steps used to move the slow-momentum decay Beta3 from Beta1 to its target. Empty uses the estimated total steps; 0 uses the target decay from the start.
field.lorarite_clip_unmagnified_gradHint: Limits the internal gradient norm independently of equivalent rescaling of the two LoRA factors. LoRA-RITE locks global max_grad_norm to 0 and uses this threshold instead. 0 disables clipping.
field.soap_max_precondition_dimHint: Maximum axis length for matrix preconditioning. Longer axes require larger matrix calculations, with stored matrices growing as the square of the axis length. Axes above the limit are not preconditioned.
field.soap_precondition_frequencyHint: Number of steps between recalculations of the update’s coordinate basis. Longer intervals cost less but adapt more slowly to recent gradient changes.
field.soap_shampoo_betaHint: Moving-average coefficient of the preconditioner itself; leave it empty to follow the second beta. Larger values keep more history in the basis.
field.soap_normalize_gradientHint: Normalizes each update tensor by its RMS to reduce differences in update scale.
field.soap_correct_biasHint: Corrects the early-training bias caused by statistics starting at zero. Learning-rate warmup is configured separately with lr_warmup_steps.
field.soap_precondition_1dHint: Also builds matrix preconditioners for 1-D parameters such as normalization weights when train_norm is on; those statistics cost the same square-of-length memory, so it is off by default.
field.stopcoefHint: Triggers a convergence signal once training settles and recent average loss is at or below this value. Higher values trigger it more easily; 0 disables it.
field.notifyHint: Prints the convergence signal as READY TO STOP. Controls logging only; it does not stop training.
field.use_shadowHint: Keeps shadow weights and mixes them with current weights when the loss changes sharply, using additional VRAM. Disabled by default.
field.learning_rateHint_emosens: Enter a multiplier here; EmoSens adjusts the actual learning rate automatically. Start with 0.1 for Transformer / DiT LoRA (such as Anima and MOSS-Image) or 1.0 for U-Net LoRA (such as SDXL). Keep the original value when resuming.
field.component_lrHint_emosens: This field does not change EmoSens's actual rate; all components share the base multiplier. Component training switches determine what is trained.
field.learning_rateHint_automagic: Starting learning rate for automatic adjustment, bounded by the minimum and maximum during training. The default ceiling of 1e3 provides numerical protection.
field.learning_rateHint_prodigy: This is a multiplier for the adaptive step size, combined with the estimated D value. Its number is not comparable to an AdamW learning rate.
field.learning_rateHint_adafactor_relative: AdaFactor currently computes the step size internally; this value does not control updates. Disable both relative_step and warmup_init to use a manual rate.
field.learning_rateHint_adafactor_manual: Uses a manual learning rate and external scheduling. With scale_parameter enabled, the step is also scaled by parameter RMS.
field.prodigy_d_coefHint: Controls the estimation scale for the automatic step size D, default 1.0.
field.prodigy_d0Hint: Initial estimate of the automatic step size D, default 1e-6.
field.prodigy_safeguard_warmupHint: Enabled automatically with external LR warmup so warmup does not disturb the D estimate.
field.prodigyplus_use_stableadamwHint: Limits the magnitude of internal optimizer updates by scaling down oversized updates.
field.d_limiterHint: Limits the per-step increase in D. With d_coef=1, D grows by at most about 19% per step. SPEED does not read this setting.
field.schedulefree_cHint: Controls how strongly the saved weight average favors recent training results. Larger positive values give recent results more weight and respond faster; 0 uses the original averaging rule.
field.prodigy_stepsHint: Stops updating D and releases its estimation buffers after this many steps. 0 keeps estimating throughout training.
field.use_speedHint: Uses the SPEED estimator: increases D when directional progress reaches a new peak, stores less estimation state, and applies its own growth limit. Emits a warning when combined with nonzero weight decay.
field.use_bias_correctionHint: Uses RAdam-style correction to adjust early updates according to the accumulated second-moment statistics. If D stays unchanged after enabling it, compare with it disabled.
field.use_cautiousHint: Masks update components that disagree with the current gradient, then normalizes by the retained fraction.
field.use_orthogradHint: Removes the gradient component parallel to the current weights, then uses the remaining gradient to update parameters.
field.factoredHint: Approximates full second-moment statistics with row and column statistics to save memory, introducing approximation error.
field.factored_fp32Hint: Stores row and column statistics in FP32 when enabled, or in the gradient dtype when disabled. Disabling saves no state memory with FP32 gradients. Applies only with factored second moments.
field.split_groupsHint: Estimates step sizes separately for each parameter group, allowing the backbone and text encoder to adapt independently. Disabling this uses one shared estimate.
field.split_groups_mean: Share an averaged D across groups
field.split_groups_meanHint: Combines the separate group estimates using their harmonic mean, which is more influenced by smaller values. Applies only when per-group estimation is enabled.
field.weight_decay_by_lr: Scale weight decay with the learning rate
field.weight_decay_by_lrHint: When enabled, multiplies weight decay by the optimizer's adaptive step size. When disabled, omits that multiplier. Has no effect with weight_decay=0.
field.schedulefree_warmup_stepsHint: The optimizer gradually raises the learning rate at the start of training. Set the warmup length here; external warmup settings have no effect.
field.adafactor_relative_stepHint: AdaFactor computes the update step size from the training step count; the entered rate, external scheduler, and LoRA+ group rates do not control updates. Turn off both this and warmup_init to use manual learning rates.
field.adafactor_scale_parameterHint: Scales the step by each parameter's root mean square (RMS). Disable to omit parameter-scale multiplication.
field.adafactor_warmup_initHint: Only used with relative_step; warmup is then managed inside AdaFactor.
field.adafactor_clip_thresholdHint: Bounds the RMS of AdaFactor's internal update. Updates above the threshold are scaled down; lower values impose a stronger limit. Separate from global gradient clipping.
field.adafactor_epsHint: Two-value format: eps1, eps2. eps1 applies to squared-gradient statistics and eps2 applies to parameter-scale calculation.
field.betasHint: Enter comma-separated moving-average coefficients. AdamW and similar optimizers take two values; CAME, Adan, and AdEMAMix take three. See the selected optimizer's documentation for each value's role.
field.betasHint_adam: Beta1 smooths gradient directions; Beta2 smooths squared-gradient statistics. Higher values retain more history and respond more slowly to changes.
field.betasHint_lion: Beta1 sets how much past momentum contributes to the current update direction. Beta2 sets how much history is retained for later updates.
field.betasHint_came: The three values smooth update direction, gradient magnitude, and update residuals. The third helps estimate update reliability.
field.betasHint_prodigy: Beta1 smooths update directions; Beta2 smooths squared-gradient statistics. Automatic step-size estimation is separate, so these values do not determine the effective learning rate on their own.
field.betasHint_schedulefree: Beta1 controls the blend of training and averaged weights. Beta2 smooths gradient-magnitude statistics.
field.betasHint_adan: The three values control the gradient average, the average change between gradients, and squared lookahead statistics. Higher values make those statistics respond more slowly.
field.betasHint_ademamix: Beta1 tracks short-term trends, Beta2 tracks squared gradients, and Beta3 tracks long-term trends. A Beta3 closer to 1 makes the long-term history decay more slowly.
field.betasHint_soap: Beta1 and Beta2 smooth gradient and squared-gradient statistics in the transformed coordinates. A separate setting controls decay in the preconditioner statistics.
field.epsHint: Numerical protection for update scaling. AdamW adds it to a denominator; Muon uses it as a denominator floor. Adjust when investigating division by zero, NaNs, or excessive amplification.
field.epsHint_lorarite: This value is squared before use. Do not copy AdamW’s epsilon value directly.
field.epsHint_prodigyplus: Set to None to use Adam-atan2 (scale invariant, no eps needed); internal update scaling is then disabled and global gradient clipping is locked to 0.
field.automagic_min_lrHint: Floor for the adapted rate. Requires minimum ≤ starting learning rate ≤ maximum.
field.automagic_max_lrHint: Hard ceiling for the adapted rate. The default 1e3 is a numerical guard; lower it to constrain the controller's growth.
field.automagic_beta2Hint: History retention for squared-gradient statistics. Values closer to 1 retain history longer.
field.automagic_clip_thresholdHint: First clips the internal update RMS, then clips each update component to ±this threshold. Calculated separately from global max_grad_norm.
field.automagic_polarity_historyHint: Tracks recent gradient-sign agreement for each parameter. A longer window retains more sign history and responds more slowly to new sign changes.
field.automagic_fusedLocked: Set to off. Reason: fused mode requires one GPU, gradient accumulation of 1, max_grad_norm of 0, and no FP16.
field.gradient_accumulation_steps_emosensLocke: EmoSens currently does not support gradient accumulation. This value is fixed at 1.
field.emosensMultiGpuConflict: EmoSens conflict: gpu_ids is {value}; one GPU is required
field.came_weight_decoupleHint: When disabled, weight_decay enters the gradient as an L2 term. This switch has no effect when weight_decay=0.
field.came_fixed_decay: Keep per-step weight decay strength fixed
field.came_fixed_decayHint: Applies only with decoupled weight decay enabled. When enabled, the decay coefficient is no longer multiplied by the current learning rate.
field.came_clip_thresholdHint: Limits the root mean square of CAME's internal update tensor; this is separate from global max_grad_norm.
field.came_ams_boundHint: Uses the historical maximum second-moment estimate to bound adaptive step sizes so the denominator statistic cannot fall below the largest value recorded earlier.
field.came_eps1Hint: Added to squared-gradient statistics to prevent a zero normalization denominator. Default: 1e-30.
field.came_eps2Hint: Added to squared update-minus-momentum statistics for confidence scaling. Default: 1e-16. This scaling applies to the factorized-state path.
field.optimizer_args_customHint: Enter one supported constructor argument per line, such as amsgrad=False. Use Python literals, including True/False for booleans. Use this for parameters not listed in the form.
field.optimizerSwitchReset: Learning rates and optimizer parameters were reset; custom optimizer arguments were cleared.
field.optimizerSwitchRestored: Restored the learning rates and parameters last edited for this optimizer.
field.lr_warmup_steps_internalLocked: This optimizer or piecewise constant scheduler does not use external warmup, so this value is fixed at 0.
field.lr_scheduler_locked: This optimizer manages its own schedule. The external schedule is fixed to constant.
field.max_grad_norm_optimizerLocked: Global gradient clipping is disabled for this optimizer configuration and fixed at 0.
field.learning_rate_prodigyLocked: Prodigy estimates the step size automatically. This multiplier is fixed at 1.
field.unet_lr_prodigyLocked: Prodigy uses the same learning rate multiplier for all components. This value is fixed at 1.
field.text_encoder_lr_prodigyLocked: Prodigy uses the same learning rate multiplier for all components. This value is fixed at 1.
field.network_dimHint: For standard LoRA, a higher rank allows a wider range of weight changes and increases the parameter count and file size. LoHa and LoKr use dimension settings differently.
field.network_dimHint_lora_muon: Higher ranks allow a wider range of LoRA weight changes, at the cost of more parameters and matrix computation.
field.network_alphaHint: Standard LoRA scales adapter outputs by Alpha/Rank. Reassess the learning rate after changing Alpha.
field.network_alphaHint_lora_muon: The LoRA branch scales by Alpha/Rank, affecting training gradients. Alpha need not equal Rank; recheck the learning rate after changing it.
field.network_weightsHint: Starts from an existing LoRA without restoring optimizer state or training progress. Use Resume training state to restore the optimizer, scheduler, and other saved state.
field.train_adalnHint: Adds adapters for AdaLN modulation layers to the existing scope, training feature scales, offsets, and branch strengths across noise timesteps. Increases the parameter count and weight-file size.
field.enable_loraplusHint: Uses different learning rates for the adapter's two parameter groups. Set the ratio below; parameter count is unchanged.
field.enable_loraplus_optimizerLocked: Set to off. Reason: the current trainer does not support LoRA+ with Prodigy, ProdigyPlusScheduleFree, EmoSens, LoRA-RITE, or LoRA-Muon; AdaFactor requires both relative_step and warmup_init to be disabled.
field.loraplus_lr_ratioHint: Designated group rate = component rate × ratio; 1 gives both groups the same rate. Separate component ratios take priority.
field.loraplus_unet_lr_ratioHint: Leave blank to use the global LoRA+ ratio.
field.loraplus_unet_lr_ratioHint_anima: Leave blank to use the global LoRA+ ratio.
field.loraplus_text_encoder_lr_ratioHint: Applies only when training the text encoder. Leave blank to use the global LoRA+ ratio.
field.scale_weight_norms: Maximum norm regularization for network weights
field.network_args_customHint: Enter one key=value pair per line. The LoRA+ controls manage its ratios; duplicate entries here do not override them.
field.base_weightsHint: LoRA weight paths merged before training, separated by commas.
field.base_weights_multiplierHint: Merge multiplier per base_weights entry, comma-separated; the count must match.
field.keep_tokensHint: Preserves the first N tags during shuffling and per-tag dropout. Whole-caption dropout still clears them. N counts tags separated by the caption separator, a comma by default.
field.shuffle_captionHint: Randomly shuffles caption tags while keeping retained tags in place. Requires disabling both memory and disk text caches.
field.weighted_captionsHint: Parses caption weights such as (red hair:1.2). Supported by SDXL only, not Anima.
field.caption_dropout_rateHint: Replaces the whole caption with empty text at this probability; the image still trains. For example, 0.1 gives about 10% of samples empty captions. 0 disables it.
field.caption_dropout_rateHint_sdxl: Replaces the whole caption with empty text at this probability; the image still trains. 0 disables it. Cannot be combined with text-encoder output caching.
field.caption_dropout_rateHint_anima: Uses an empty caption at this probability; the image still trains. Supports text-encoder output caching, but rebuild existing disk text caches after changing the rate. 0 disables it.
field.caption_dropout_every_n_epochs: Use empty captions every N epochs
field.caption_dropout_every_n_epochsHint: Uses empty captions for every sample in epochs N, 2N, 3N, and so on. Other epochs still use the dropout probability. 0 disables this; a positive value turns off both memory and disk text caches.
field.caption_tag_dropout_rateHint: Probability of randomly dropping tags; retained tags are exempt. 0 disables dropout. Above 0, disable both memory and disk text caches.
field.sample_promptsHint: Enter one positive prompt per line; each produces one preview image. Use tags or natural language, for example: 1girl, smile, cherry blossoms.
field.sample_promptsHint_anima: Enter one positive prompt per line; each produces one preview image. With text caching enabled, finalize the prompts before training starts.
field.sample_cfgHint: Controls how much the difference between positive and negative predictions is amplified in previews. 1 disables CFG. Only affects preview generation.
field.sampleResolutionHint: Preview dimensions. Larger images use more VRAM; reduce the size if previews run out of memory.
field.sample_seedHint: Keep the prompt and seed fixed to compare changes across training checkpoints.
field.sample_stepsHint: Preview denoising steps. More steps take longer; keep this fixed when comparing training results.
field.negative_promptsHint: All lines are combined into one negative prompt shared by all preview images. May be empty; has no effect at CFG=1.
field.negative_promptsHint_anima: All lines are combined into one negative prompt shared by all preview images. May be empty and has no effect at CFG=1. With text caching enabled, finalize it before training starts.
field.mixed_precisionHint: Uses lower precision for part of the training computation to reduce VRAM. Weight and optimizer-state precision also depend on the model format, optimizer, and other precision settings.
field.full_bf16: Cast model and LoRA parameters to BF16
field.full_bf16Hint: Keeps model and trainable parameters in BF16 as well as using BF16 computation. Can save more GPU memory, with lower parameter precision than regular mixed-precision training.
field.full_bf16_automagicLocked: Automagic3 compatibility mode requires FP32 LoRA trainable parameters; full_bf16 is disabled.
field.xformersHint: Requires a compatible xformers installation and focuses on reducing attention VRAM use. Enabling this turns off PyTorch SDPA.
field.sdpaHint: Uses PyTorch's built-in attention without extra extensions. Enabling this turns off xformers.
field.cache_latentsHint: Reuses VAE image encodings to speed up training. Supports cached horizontal flips; incompatible with random cropping.
field.cache_latents_to_diskHint: Stores image encodings on disk to reduce resident memory use and reuse them in future runs; enables latent caching. Rebuild after changing images, the VAE, or preprocessing settings.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputs_to_disk: Save text encoder outputs to disk
field.cache_text_encoder_outputs_to_diskHint: Saves text encodings to disk for reuse in later training runs; also enables text caching. Rebuild disk text caches after changing captions, the text encoder, or token limits.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputs_to_diskHint_a: Saves text encodings to disk for reuse in later training runs; also enables text caching. Rebuild disk text caches after changing captions, the text encoder, token limits, or whole-caption dropout probability.
field.no_half_vaeHint: Uses full-precision VAE computation to avoid NaNs from half-precision overflow. Increases VAE VRAM use.
field.lowramHint: Keeps more model data in VRAM to reduce system RAM use. Intended for limited RAM with spare VRAM; does not save VRAM.
field.seedHint: Controls random initialization, data shuffling, and noise sampling. Use the same seed when comparing settings.
field.v_parameterizationHint: Used only by SDXL models trained with a v-prediction target; it must match the base model objective.
field.zero_terminal_snrHint: Used only by SDXL and requires v_parameterization to be enabled.
field.max_grad_normHint: Scales gradients down when their norm exceeds the threshold, limiting unusually large updates from individual batches. Very low thresholds can suppress useful learning. Set to 0 to disable.
field.max_grad_normHint_lora_muon: Global L2 gradient clipping is disabled by default. A positive value clips gradients at this threshold before the optimizer update.
field.huber_schedule: Huber threshold schedule over noise timesteps
field.huber_cHint: Base threshold, default 0.1. constant uses this value × huber_scale; exponential computes the threshold from the noise timestep, then multiplies by huber_scale. snr computes it from the noise level without huber_scale.
field.huber_scaleHint: Scales the threshold computed by constant and exponential. Default: 1.0. snr does not use this value.
field.qwen3Hint: Enter a .safetensors file path or a local HuggingFace model directory.
field.timestep_samplingHint: Sets how often each noise timestep is sampled. Higher timesteps contain more noise; lower timesteps retain more original image information. Inspect each range's share in the distribution preview.
field.sigmoid_scaleHint: Controls the base distribution's width for sigmoid, shift, and flux_shift. Without offsets or shifts, lower values concentrate sampling around medium noise, while higher values increase sampling at both ends.
field.discrete_flow_shiftHint: Above 1 favors high noise; below 1 favors low noise; 1 leaves the grid unshifted. Used by shift, sigma, and truncated_logit_normal.
field.krea_discrete_flow_shiftHint: Used only with shift sampling. Above 1 favors high noise; below 1 favors low noise; 1 leaves the distribution unchanged.
field.krea_sigmoid_scaleHint: Controls the base distribution width for sigmoid, shift, flux_shift, and krea2_shift. Before shifting, smaller values concentrate sampling at medium noise and larger values increase both tails. Shift settings also affect the final distribution.
field.weighting_schemeHint: sigma_sqrt and cosmap adjust loss weights by noise level. logit_normal and mode only change the sigma sampling distribution, without adding loss weighting. uniform adds no adjustment.
field.logit_meanHint: Used by sigma + logit_normal and truncated_logit_normal. Higher values favor low noise; lower values favor high noise.
field.logit_stdHint: Used by sigma + logit_normal and truncated_logit_normal. Lower values concentrate samples; higher values cover a wider noise range. Must be positive in truncated mode.
field.timestep_cutoffHint: Used by truncated_logit_normal, in (0, 1]; default 0.95. Samples are rescaled after truncation to cover the full noise range.
field.timestep_uniform_ratioHint: Used by truncated_logit_normal, in [0, 1]. Default 0.01 draws 1% of samples uniformly from the timestep grid.
field.timestep_cutoffError: The truncation cutoff must be greater than 0 and at most 1.
field.timestep_uniform_ratioError: The uniform sampling ratio must be between 0 and 1.
field.truncatedLogitStdError: Truncated sampling requires a positive standard deviation.
field.mode_scaleHint: Used only with sigma + mode. 0 samples noise-table indices uniformly; increasing it from 0 to the default 1.29 concentrates indices around the table's middle. Check the distribution preview for other values.
field.min_timestepHint: Inclusive lower bound for SDXL timestep sampling. Raising it excludes lower-noise timesteps. Blank uses 0.
field.max_timestepHint: Exclusive upper bound for SDXL timestep sampling. For example, 500 allows timesteps up to 499. Blank uses 1000.
field.textTokenLengthHint: Counts the tokens produced by the model's tokenizer. Captions exceeding the limit are truncated.
field.attn_modeHint: torch uses built-in SDPA; flash and xformers require their extensions.
field.split_attnHint: Computes attention separately for each sample, reducing padding overhead in batches with variable text lengths. Enabled automatically when xformers is selected.
field.split_attnXformersLocked: xformers requires split attention, so this option stays enabled.
field.vae_chunk_sizeHint: Splits VAE convolutions into feature-map chunks. Smaller values reduce each chunk's intermediate tensors and increase the number of chunks. Enter a positive even number; blank disables chunking.
field.vae_disable_cacheHint: Disables temporal feature caches in the 3D VAE encoder and decoder, removing those cache tensors from memory. For single-frame images only. Has no effect with the 2D VAE.
field.blocks_to_swapHint: Keeps this many DiT blocks in system RAM and loads them onto the GPU before computation. Higher counts reduce resident model VRAM and add CPU/GPU transfers. 0 disables swapping.
field.blocks_to_swapHint_anima: Moves some DiT blocks to system RAM to save VRAM, increasing RAM use and transfer overhead. Swap up to 26 of 28 blocks; 0 disables swapping. Incompatible with CPU or Unsloth activation offloading.
field.conv_dimHint: Sets a separate rank for non-1x1 convolutions (e.g. 3x3) in LyCORIS modules; 1x1 convolutions keep using network_dim, and an empty value falls back to network_dim.
field.conv_dimHintNative: Sets the rank for convolutions other than 1×1. Leaving it empty excludes those convolutions from training; 1×1 convolutions still use network_dim.
field.conv_alphaHint: Sets Alpha for LyCORIS convolutions other than 1×1; empty uses network_alpha. 1×1 convolutions use network_alpha.
field.conv_alphaHintNative: Sets Alpha for convolutions other than 1×1; empty uses 1.0. 1×1 convolutions use network_alpha.
field.conv_dimHintNative_anima: The Anima DiT backbone has no target convolution layers. This setting has no effect and can be left empty.
field.conv_dimHint_anima: The Anima DiT backbone has no target convolution layers. This setting has no effect and can be left empty.
field.conv_alphaHintNative_anima: The Anima DiT backbone has no target convolution layers. This setting has no effect and can be left empty.
field.conv_alphaHint_anima: The Anima DiT backbone has no target convolution layers. This setting has no effect and can be left empty.
field.lokr_factorHint: Controls how dimensions are split between LoKr’s two factors, affecting the parameter count and the weight changes the adapter can represent. Use -1 for automatic selection; check the structure preview for the result.
field.use_tuckerHint: Applies Tucker decomposition to non-1x1 convolution layers to reduce parameter count; it has no effect when the selected preset targets no convolution layers.
field.use_tuckerHintNative: Applies Tucker decomposition to non-1x1 convolution layers to reduce parameter count.
field.use_scalarHint: Multiplies the module output by a trainable scaling coefficient that is learned during training; supported only by some LyCORIS algorithms.
field.decompose_bothHint: Allows low-rank decomposition of both Kronecker factors, depending on layer dimensions and Rank. See the structure preview for the resulting parameter count.
field.full_matrixHint: Stores LoKr factors as full matrices, which can add adapter parameters. Training remains limited to the LoKr adapter, with base weights frozen.
field.train_normHint: Used only by LyCORIS to train LayerNorm and GroupNorm.
field.train_llm_adapterHint: Trains adapters for Anima's LLM Adapter to adjust text conditioning fusion. Supports native LoRA, LoHa, LoKr, and LyCORIS. This switch alone does not unfreeze Qwen and can be used with text caching.
field.rank_dropoutHint: Probability of masking low-rank channels during standard LoRA training. 0 disables it.
field.module_dropoutHint: Probability of skipping a layer's entire adapter and using only the base-model output. 0 disables it.
field.lycoris_dropoutHint: Sets feature dropout for LyCORIS to reduce reliance on fixed feature combinations. Overrides the general feature dropout setting when specified. Support depends on the algorithm.
field.lycoris_algoHint: Selects the LyCORIS parameterization. Only options supported by the current algorithm are shown.
field.lycorisNoteFullMatrixFactor: Full-matrix mode removes low-rank decomposition within the factors, not the Kronecker structure. The factor setting still applies, and the base model is not fully fine-tuned.
field.lycorisNoteTrainLlmAdapter: train_llm_adapter expands training targets to LLM adapter layers.
field.lycorisNoteDimFullMatrix: LoKr decides whether to factorize each layer using its matrix dimensions. At the layer's rank threshold, the corresponding factor becomes a full matrix; further rank increases add no parameters to that factor. Check each layer in the structure preview.
field.lycoris_presetHint: Chooses which DiT/UNet, text-encoder, attention, MLP, or convolution modules are trained.
field.lycoris_anima_sd_defaultHint: Matches the sd-scripts native default: only attention and MLP of each Block are trained; the AdaLN modulation branches, embeddings, the output layer, and norm layers stay excluded.
field.lycoris_anima_train_adalnHint: Adds AdaLN modulation layers when the attn-mlp preset is aligned with the sd-scripts default scope.
field.lycoris_kernel_backendHint: Auto selects an available adapter backend. Backends requiring compilation add time to the first run.
field.dora_wdHint: Separates adapted weights into direction and trainable magnitude. Turn off Bypass for ordinary layers: the current bypass path does not apply DoRA magnitude. Feature dropout is not used when reconstructing weights.
field.bypass_modeHint: Computes adapter output without rebuilding the full weight matrix. Some quantized layers enable this automatically. Disable it for DoRA on ordinary layers, or magnitude parameters have no effect.
field.rs_loraHint: Changes low-rank branch scaling from Alpha/Rank to Alpha/√Rank. This increases the scale at the same Alpha; recheck the learning rate after switching.
field.unbalanced_factorizationHint: Changes how dimensions are allocated between the two factors. Compare the resulting shapes and file size in the structure preview.
field.wd_on_outputHint: When enabled, learns one magnitude per output channel. When disabled, learns one magnitude per input channel.
field.torch_compileHint: Compiles the training model and may speed up training. The first run takes extra time to compile.
field.dynamo_backendHint: inductor favors performance; eager favors compatibility; cudagraphs reduces launch overhead.
field.dim_from_weights: Infer LoRA rank from existing weights
field.dim_from_weightsHint: Reads the rank from the existing LoRA instead of using the manually entered network dimension.
field.cuda_allow_tf32Hint: Accelerates FP32 matrix operations on Ampere or newer GPUs.
field.cuda_cudnn_benchmarkHint: Selects faster convolution algorithms for fixed input shapes.
field.qwen_image_vae_2dHint: Reuses the same VAE weights with equivalent 2D computation to speed up single-image encoding and previews and save VRAM. Disable for the original 3D path. 2D mode does not use temporal caching.
field.vae_disable_cache2dLocked: The 2D VAE has no temporal cache, so this setting has no effect. Switch back to the 3D VAE to edit it; its saved value is preserved.
field.vae_chunk_sizeHint_anima: Spatial VAE chunk size; use a positive even number, or leave blank for no chunking. Full-image activations and attention dominate peak VRAM with the 2D VAE, so chunking provides limited additional savings.
field.gradient_checkpointingHint_anima: Recomputes intermediate tensors during backpropagation to trade compute time for VRAM. Disabling it also disables dependent activation offloading.
field.max_data_loader_n_workersHint_anima: Increase the number of workers if data loading holds up training, at the cost of RAM. 0 loads in the main process; blank uses up to 8 workers. On Windows, 2 is a starting point.
field.vae_batch_sizeHint: Number of images encoded together. Blank uses 1. Lower it if image-cache preparation runs out of VRAM.
field.cpu_offload_checkpointingHint: Moves intermediate tensors needed for gradient checkpointing to system RAM, saving VRAM at the cost of transfers. Requires gradient checkpointing; incompatible with Unsloth activation offloading and block swapping.
field.unsloth_offload_checkpointingHint: Asynchronously moves intermediate tensors needed for gradient checkpointing to system RAM to reduce transfer waits. Requires gradient checkpointing; incompatible with standard CPU activation offloading and block swapping.
field.compileHint: Compiles each DiT block and may improve training speed. Cannot be enabled alongside Accelerate compilation.
field.compile_fullgraphHint: Requires torch.compile to capture the complete computation graph without graph breaks.
field.compile_fullgraphHint_anima: Requires each DiT block to compile without graph breaks. Incompatible with block swapping, split attention, and xformers.
field.compile_cache_size_limitHint: Limits cached compiled variants of computation functions. Bucket changes trigger recompilation when an existing graph cannot be reused. At the limit, execution falls back to uncompiled code.
field.persistent_data_loader_workersHint: Keeps workers alive between epochs to reduce Windows startup waits, but retains their RAM use. Automatically disabled with 0 workers.
field.persistent_data_loader_workersLocked: The worker count is 0. Data loads in the main process, so there are no worker processes to keep alive.
field.max_data_loader_n_workersHint: Upper limit on parallel data-loading workers. 0 loads in the main process. Increase gradually if training waits for data; lower it if system RAM runs short.
field.save_last_n_epochsHint: Keeps the latest N epoch-based model saves. Does not control step-based saves or the model saved at training end. Blank sets no retention limit.
field.save_state_on_train_end: Save final training state at training end
field.save_state_on_train_endHint: Enable this when you only need the final state. Save resumable training state already includes saving at the end, so enabling both is unnecessary.
field.debiased_estimation_lossHint: Reduces the relative loss weight of low-noise timesteps. With Min-SNR enabled, the weights multiply. The formula also depends on noise prediction versus v-prediction.
field.noise_offset_random_strengthHint: When enabled, the offset strength is sampled randomly between 0 and noise_offset.
field.noise_offsetHint: Adds a spatially shared random noise offset to each latent channel of each image. This value sets its strength. Blank or 0 disables it.
field.adaptive_noise_scaleHint: Adjusts offset strength using the absolute spatial mean of each latent channel: final strength = noise_offset + this value × absolute channel mean, clamped to at least 0. Applies only with nonzero noise_offset.
field.min_snr_gammaHint: Clamps SNR at γ to reduce the relative loss weight of low-noise timesteps. Blank or 0 disables it. Multiplies with debiased weighting when both are enabled; see the guide for formulas.
field.multires_noise_iterationsHint: Adds up to N layers of low-resolution noise and normalizes the result; 0 disables it. When combined with noise offset, applies the offset before adding multiresolution noise.
field.multires_noise_discountHint: Multiplies noise layer i by discount^i, starting at i=0. Within 0–1, higher values retain more of the later low-resolution noise layers. Applies only when multires noise is enabled.
field.ip_noise_gammaHint: Adds extra random noise when noising the model input; this value controls its strength. The prediction target still uses the original noise. Supported by SDXL and Anima; empty or 0 adds none.
field.ip_noise_gamma_random_strength: Random strength for input perturbation noise
field.ip_noise_gamma_random_strengthHint: When enabled, the perturbation strength is sampled randomly between 0 and ip_noise_gamma.
field.prior_loss_weightHint: Multiplies regularization-image loss by this value, leaving training-image loss unchanged. 1 adds no scaling; 0 excludes regularization loss. Applies only when regularization data is enabled.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputsHint: Encodes training captions in advance and reuses the outputs during training, avoiding repeated text encoding.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputsHint_sdxl: Pre-encodes captions to avoid repeated text encoding during training. Enabling this switches to training UNet only. Incompatible with caption dropout, tag shuffling, tag dropout, and token warmup.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputsHint_anima: Pre-encodes captions so Qwen can be moved to the CPU to free VRAM during training. Enabling this switches to training DiT only. Supports whole-caption dropout; tag shuffling, tag dropout, epoch-based dropout, and token warmup require disabling caching.
field.cache_text_encoder_outputsLocked: The current caption processing settings are incompatible with text caching.
field.network_dropoutHint: Probability of masking intermediate features during standard LoRA training. 0 disables it.
field.scale_weight_normsHint: Limits the norm of the adapter's weight change after each update. For standard LoRA, measures (Alpha/rank) × B × A and scales both A and B down when the limit is exceeded. Blank disables it.
field.sample_flow_shiftHint: Shifts preview denoising steps across the noise range. Values above 1 favor higher noise; values below 1 favor lower noise; 1 applies no shift. Affects previews only.
field.samplePromptsCountHint: {n} prompt lines → {n} preview images per sample
field.max_train_epochsHint: One epoch samples each image according to its repeat count. Updates also depend on batch size, gradient accumulation, and partial bucket batches; check the step estimate.
field.lycoris_dropoutHint_lokr: In the bypass path, randomly masks adapter outputs to reduce reliance on fixed feature combinations. The weight-rebuild path does not use this setting.
field.rank_dropoutHint_lokr: In the weight-rebuild path, randomly masks the adapter update for some output channels. The bypass path does not use this setting.
field.network_alphaHint_lokr_full: When both factors are full matrices, Alpha is set to the network dimension. The scale is 1 with rs_lora off, or the square root of the dimension with it on.
field.loraplus_lr_ratioHint_standard_lora: lora_up uses component rate × ratio; lora_down uses the component rate. 1 gives equal rates. Separate component ratios take priority.
field.block_swap_h2d_onlyHint: Avoids copying weights back to CPU and can speed up block swapping. Requires CUDA and gradient checkpointing. Buffers add VRAM; increase swapped blocks if needed.
field.block_swap_ring_sizeHint: Default 2 overlaps transfers with computation. 1 saves VRAM without overlap. Capped at the swapped block count.
field.use_pinned_memory_for_block_swapHint: Used when transferring weights to GPU only. Can speed up transfers but increases pinned RAM and Windows shared GPU memory use. Off by default.
field.blockSwapH2dRequiresBlocks: Requires at least one swapped block.
field.convrot_int8Hint: Quantizes frozen main DiT blocks to INT8 at load time to save VRAM. Also required for pre-quantized ConvRot base weights. Cannot be combined with FP8 or Turbo DiT. Triton provides acceleration; without it, computation falls back to BF16.
field.convrot_int8_bwdHint: Defaults to bf16, computing with dequantized weights. int8 quantizes backward gradients and requires Triton. With gradient checkpointing, int8 usually provides no noticeable speedup.
field.preserve_distribution_shapeHint: When off, scales the distribution into the range. When on, resamples the original distribution and keeps only in-range timesteps. If retries cannot fill a batch, sampling falls back to the original distribution and may exceed the range. Unused by sigma sampling.
field.num_timestep_bucketsHint: Divides sampling probability into intervals and cycles through them while retaining the selected distribution's overall shape. Minimum 2; leave blank to disable.
field.krea_timestep_rangeHint: 0 ≤ minimum < maximum ≤ 1000. Direct samplers limit noise timesteps; sigma limits scheduler indices, where higher indices mean less noise.
field.save_last_n_stepsHint: For step-based saves, remove checkpoints older than this step window. Leave blank to keep all.
field.save_last_n_steps_stateHint: Retention window for training states saved by step. Leave blank to use the checkpoint retention setting.
field.turbo_loraHint: Select a RAW-to-Turbo LoRA in Kohya format. It is added to the training RAW base for previews and disabled during training. Supports block swap and ConvRot INT8; leave Turbo DiT empty. Add --l 1 --s 8 to the prompt to disable CFG and sample in 8 steps.
field.turbo_lora_multiplierHint: Scales only the sampling Turbo LoRA delta; defaults to 1.0.
field.kreaQuantizationConflict: ConvRot INT8 and FP8 cannot be enabled together.
field.krea_fp8ConvrotLocked: ConvRot INT8 is enabled, so FP8 stays off. Disable ConvRot INT8 to use FP8.
field.krea_convrotTurboLocked: A full Turbo DiT is selected for previews. Clear Turbo DiT to use ConvRot INT8; Turbo LoRA is available as an alternative.
field.krea_blocksTurboLocked: Full Turbo DiT previews require block swap to be 0. Clear Turbo DiT to use block swap; Turbo LoRA is available as an alternative.
field.krea_turboDitLocked: Full Turbo DiT requires ConvRot INT8 off, block swap set to 0 and Turbo LoRA empty. Use Turbo LoRA for previews with INT8 or block swap.
field.krea_turboLoraLocked: A full Turbo DiT is selected. Clear Turbo DiT to use Turbo LoRA.
field.kreaTurboQuantizationConflict: Turbo DiT does not support ConvRot INT8 yet.
field.kreaTurboSourceConflict: Choose either Turbo DiT or Turbo LoRA.
field.kreaTimestepRangeError: Maximum timestep must exceed minimum timestep.
field.krea_latent_cache_deviceHint: Select the VAE encoding device. Auto prefers GPU; CPU uses system RAM and is usually slower.
field.krea_text_cache_deviceHint: Select where Qwen3-VL builds text caches. CPU helps when VRAM is limited, at lower speed. Training preview prompts are still encoded on GPU.
field.krea_latent_cache_batch_sizeHint: Images encoded by the VAE at once, independent of the training batch size. Larger batches may speed up caching and use more RAM or VRAM.
field.krea_cache_num_workersHint: Threads used to read images or captions during caching. Too many increase RAM use and disk contention.
field.krea_cache_reuseHint: Checks image and text caches separately. Changes to data, models, or related settings rebuild the affected stage. Turn off to rebuild both.
field.krea_cache_vae_tilingHint: Encodes large images in overlapping tiles to reduce peak cache VRAM. It can be slower and slightly change latent values. Changing this setting rebuilds image caches.
field.krea_adamw_fusedHint: Auto follows PyTorch's selection. When enabled, fused updates reduce optimizer kernel calls.
field.krea_split_attnHint: Auto disables splitting for SDPA and enables it for other backends. Splitting can reduce peak attention memory but adds calls. Required for xFormers.
field.krea_enable_loraplusHint: Sets a learning-rate multiplier for LoRA Up; LoRA Down uses the base rate. Rank and Alpha must be configured manually.
field.krea_loraplus_structureConflict: To use LoRA+, turn off structure inference from weights and set Rank and Alpha manually.

krea2.int8ModelAutoConfigured: INT8 base model detected. ConvRot INT8 is enabled and FP8 is off.
krea2.sampleModeRaw: Current preview: RAW ({precision}) + the LoRA being trained. Use multi-step CFG sampling; choose Turbo LoRA for 8-step previews.
krea2.sampleModeTurboLora: Current preview: RAW ({precision}) + the LoRA being trained + Turbo LoRA, approximating few-step Turbo output. Add --l 1 --s 8 to the prompt.
krea2.sampleModeTurboDit: Current preview: Turbo DiT ({precision}) + the LoRA being trained. Add --l 1 --s 8 to the prompt.
